test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the overarching programme introduced in the Union Budget, 2018-19 by Government of India, for the school education sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samagra Shiksha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Samagra Shiksha** is an integrated scheme for school education extending from pre-school to class XII.
 
• It was launched by the Government of India in the Union Budget 2018-19.
 
• The scheme subsumes three earlier schemes: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA), Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA), and Teacher Education (TE).
 
• Samagra Shiksha aims to improve school effectiveness in terms of equal opportunities for schooling and equitable learning outcomes.
 
• It focuses on the holistic development of children, enhancing the quality of education at all levels of schooling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Education (RTE)**

 
 
• Enshrined in Article 21A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Makes education a fundamental right for children aged 6 to 14 years.
 
• Mandates free and compulsory education for this age group.
 
• Aims to improve literacy rates and ensure access to education for all children.
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA)**
 
 
• Launched in 2009 to enhance access to secondary education.
 
• Aimed at improving the quality of education at the secondary level.
 
• Focused on reducing the drop-out rate and enhancing the enrolment ratio.
 
• Now subsumed under the Samagra Shiksha scheme.
 
 
 
• **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)**
 
 
• Launched in 2001 to achieve universalization of elementary education.
 
• Focused on providing useful and relevant elementary education for all children.
 
• Aimed at bridging social, regional, and gender gaps in education.
 
• Now part of the Samagra Shiksha initiative.
 
 
 
• **Teacher Education (TE)**
 
 
• Aims to improve the quality of teachers through professional development.
 
• Focuses on training and re-training teachers to enhance their teaching skills.
 
• Supports continuous professional development programs for teachers.
 
• Also integrated into the Samagra Shiksha scheme.
